evidence.title: Ship UI. Keep the Taste - Flexnative

name: Flexnative UI
summary: 450 shadcn/ui blocks, patterns and illustrations with live previews, plus intent-based prompts that pick the pattern for you.
description: A registry built on shadcn/ui with three offerings: Blocks (26 page sections — heroes, content, features, CTA, bento, testimonials — in Vellum and Sienna presets), Patterns (450+ compositions such as forms, tables, dialogs, dropdowns, empty states), and Intents (descriptions of a goal like sign-in or payment that return the decision, reasoning and code). Blocks have live editing; copy the code and ship.
contains: 450 registry items across blocks, patterns and illustrations
26 blocks: hero (14), content, feature, CTA, bento grid, testimonials
24 patterns: accordion, avatar, button, card, command, dialog, dropdown, empty, forms, input, table, tabs
presets (Vellum, Sienna) that retune radius, shadow and rhythm via inherited tokens
intents: goal descriptions that return the decision, reasoning and code
